intro: Statistical foundations: convergence modes, limit theorems, concentration inequalities, and minimax lower-bound tools.

namespace_intros.Bootstrap: Bootstrap foundations: resampling distributions and consistency of bootstrap approximations.
namespace_intros.CLT: Central limit theory: iid and triangular-array CLTs, Lindeberg conditions, and vector-valued versions used by the estimation layer.
namespace_intros.Concentration: Concentration inequalities: Hoeffding/Bernstein-type bounds, bounded differences, symmetrization, empirical-process separability, entropy chaining, and empirical-Bernstein refinements.
namespace_intros.Concentration.HilbertEmpiricalMean: Dimension-free concentration of bounded Hilbert-valued empirical means: finite-product variance identities, expected-norm control, and McDiarmid confidence radii without a finite-dimensionality assumption.
namespace_intros.EmpiricalProcess: Empirical-process theory: Rademacher complexities, maximal inequalities, moduli of continuity, and uniform laws for function classes.
namespace_intros.EmpiricalProcess.Equicontinuity: Stochastic equicontinuity: asymptotic-equicontinuity criteria for empirical processes.
namespace_intros.GMM: Generalized method of moments: identification, smooth feasible-estimator expansions, asymptotic normality, and Hansen's over-identification J test.
namespace_intros.Inference: Inferential tooling: delta methods (scalar, functional, Hadamard), Wald/chi-squared statistics, and Slutsky ingredients.
namespace_intros.Limit: Convergence concepts: convergence in probability and distribution, continuous mapping, and Slutsky-style composition rules.
namespace_intros.Limit.ObservationDependentVanTrees: Observation-dependent Bayesian Cramér–Rao bounds: guarded-score algebra, absolute-continuity integration by parts, product-measure identities, and weighted L² Cauchy–Schwarz for dominated likelihood models.
namespace_intros.MEstimation: M- and Z-estimation: consistency, asymptotic normality, and influence-function representations.
namespace_intros.Minimax: Minimax lower-bound machinery: risk definitions, maximal couplings, coordinatewise overlap, Le Cam two-point methods, Pinsker/KL bridges, and rate statements for estimation problems.
namespace_intros.Minimax.FiniteSideInformation: Finite side-information minimax convergence: compact probability-simplex coordinates, finite empirical concentration, exact-side comparison, and convergence from iid side samples to observing the side-law vector.
namespace_intros.Minimax.MomentMatchedMixture.FiniteSigne: Finite signed moment marked-Poisson mixtures: normalized atomic signed moment certificates, Jordan and zero-inflated priors, aggregate and label-gated Poisson experiments, and geometric total-variation bounds for finite iid products.
namespace_intros.Minimax.FiniteSquaredLoss: Finite bounded decision problems: randomized designs, dependent finite observations, conditional mixing under squared loss, and an attaining minimax procedure with a least-favorable finite prior.
namespace_intros.Minimax.FiniteKernelBayes: Finite-state Bayes-to-minimax bridges: continuous priors mixed through Markov kernels, deterministic state maps, and finite randomization designs, all using real-valued losses.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric: Nonparametric methods: approximation theory, fixed-weight linear smoothers, local-polynomial coercivity and derivative bounds, series/sieve estimators, projection-kernel risk building blocks, and moment-problem tools.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.LocalPolynomial: General local-polynomial analysis: coordinate partial derivatives, operator-norm bounds, and coercivity of weighted radial polynomial energies.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.MomentProblems: Moment-problem substrate for nonparametric statistics: raw-moment algebra, L² projection residuals, constrained score programs, and sharp bounded-outcome residual envelopes.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.MomentProblems.ResidualQua: Residual-quadratic moment problems: moment-coordinate formulas, measure-level L² projection residuals, and projection residual orthogonality identities.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.MomentProblems.ScoreProgra: Dual score-program tools for moment problems: projection residual functions, feasible score directions, quadratic objectives, and minimum-norm identities.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.MomentProblems.BoundedOutc: Sharp bounded-outcome residual envelopes: quartic root selection, admissible laws, upper bounds, and extremal three-point attainment.
namespace_intros.Orthogonality: Neyman orthogonality as a statistical property: definitions and the second-order remainder characterization.
namespace_intros.Quantile: Quantile processes: empirical quantiles, Bahadur representations, and joint sample-quantile asymptotics.
namespace_intros.Quantile.MarkedSubsampleEmpiricalCDF: Boolean-marked subsample empirical-CDF tail-bound transfer: exact mark-word conditioning, selected-coordinate iid laws, and finite conditional aggregation of an assumed fixed-sample bound.
namespace_intros.Quantile.SampleQuantileBahadur: The Bahadur representation of sample quantiles: linearization, oscillation control, and the rate statement.
namespace_intros.Sample: Sampling primitives: iid samples as measurable maps with their product-law identities.
namespace_intros.FiniteStratumMarkedRatioMse: Finite-stratum marked ratios: totalized within-arm means, exact error decompositions, and finite-sample mean-squared-error bounds under overlap and weak moment conditions.
namespace_intros.SampleSplit: Sample splitting and cross-fitting: fold structures, split σ-algebras, and the independence facts they deliver.
namespace_intros.UStatistic: U-statistics: Hoeffding decompositions and asymptotics for degenerate and non-degenerate kernels.
namespace_intros.UStatistic.OrderM: Fixed- and mixed-order U-statistics: ordered injective tuples, partial-matching product and covariance expansions, normalization bounds, Hájek projections, variance identities, degeneracy conditions, remainder negligibility, CLTs, and the order-2 bridge.
namespace_intros.Concentration.Matrix: Matrix concentration for random design moment matrices and localized empirical Grams: iid entrywise deviation bounds, deterministic perturbation, variance-sensitive local-mass concentration, and high-probability coercivity or inverse control.
namespace_intros.PolynomialTail: Polynomial lower-tail moment analysis: the polynomial small-value tail law for a bounded positive variable, truncated inverse first/second moment asymptotics, the trimming-bias bound, and the bias-variance rate-balancing algebra.
namespace_intros.Privacy: Differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism: the centered Laplace distribution and its density-ratio bound, scalar and finite-dimensional additive-noise release, pure and approximate ε-differential-privacy guarantees, post-processing closure, and Laplace-noise moment bounds.
namespace_intros.Concentration.Covering.RealValuedVCSubgr: Real-valued VC-subgraph entropy: arbitrary-measure L² covering bounds, reusable algebraic closures, finite-dimensional parameter classes, and empirical-Dudley bridges.
namespace_intros.FiniteRaoBlackwell: Guarded finite conditional laws and Rao–Blackwell reductions for arbitrary finite-design pushforwards and uniform allocation experiments, with exact disintegration, finite-prior posteriors, factorization sufficiency, and real-valued minimax bridges.
namespace_intros.Concentration.RandomDesignWeightedHoeffd: Random-design weighted Hoeffding concentration: conditional exponential-moment and self-normalized tail bounds for bounded marks whose weights depend measurably on the entire design vector.
namespace_intros.Concentration.PoissonSelfNormalized: Self-normalized Poisson concentration: measurable deviation scales, explicit Chernoff tails, scalar weighted moments, finite independent-coordinate aggregation, and normalized exposure-scale corollaries.
namespace_intros.CLT.MartingaleArray: Scalar martingale triangular-array central limit theory: predictable variance, conditional Lindeberg and Lyapunov conditions, stopping, and characteristic-function convergence without independence.
namespace_intros.Nonparametric.MomentProblems.FiniteMomen: Finite-moment Gaussian perturbations: bounded density tilts that preserve any chosen finite segment of Gaussian moments while remaining non-Gaussian, arbitrarily close in total variation, and Carleman-certified.
namespace_intros.FiniteRaoBlackwell.IndependentPoissonPre: Independent Poisson-prefix Rao–Blackwell transfer: exact product laws, capped variable-length prefixes, conditional averaging, and two-tail depoissonization for two independent iid pools with different capacities and alphabets.

Finite-family independent Poisson-prefix Rao–Blackwell transfer: heterogeneous fixed iid pools, exact finite-product prefix laws, capped implementations, summed overflow-tail risk control, and a direct three-pool shared-law specialization.

Random-scale minimax transfer for unequal Poisson pools: exact ordered retention from two conditionally independent marked-Poisson records with a shared latent scale, scale-and-tail failure bounds, bounded-loss rule transfer, and fuzzy-prior minimax lower-bound composition.
namespace_intros.Weighted: Weighted panel estimators: weighting schemes over cohorts/periods and the estimands they aggregate to.
namespace_intros.LinearModel.GaussMarkov: The Gauss-Markov theorem for linear models: best linear unbiased estimation under spherical errors.
